headings.usage: Use for all main section headers, hero titles, and large numbers.

body.usage: Use for all paragraph text, descriptions, and UI controls.

mono.usage: Use exclusively for tax amounts, numbers, leaderboard scores, and calculator outputs.

visual_enhancers.surface_strategy: Flat Data-Dense Cards. Absolutely no heavy box-shadows. Use a crisp 1px border (#e2e8f0) with pure white backgrounds (#ffffff).
visual_enhancers.borders: rounded-lg or rounded-md for a structured, professional corporate feel. Do not use extreme pill shapes for cards.
visual_enhancers.hover_effects: Subtle translation (-translate-y-[2px]) and shadow-sm for interactive cards. Strict color contrast for text on hover.
visual_enhancers.accents: Use 2px left-border highlights using primary color for active states in sidebars or lists.

component_patterns.navigation: Collapsible left-sidebar (240px width) containing navigation links, user profile snippet, and theme toggle. Maintains vertical scaling for dashboard modules.
component_patterns.data_cards: Bento-style summary cards at the top of the dashboard. Pure white, 1px border, single key metric (using IBM Plex Mono) with a trend indicator.
component_patterns.forms_calculators: Use Shadcn pure HTML+Tailwind forms. Inputs must have clear borders, focus:ring-1 focus:ring-blue-600. No floating labels, use explicit uppercase tracking-wide labels.
component_patterns.chatbot: Floating bottom-right widget. Professional dark blue (#1e3a8a) header, white message body.
component_patterns.leaderboard: High-density table layout. Rows should have hover:bg-slate-50. Highlight the top 3 rows with subtle background tints.
component_patterns.quiz_interface: Clean, distraction-free center container (max-w-2xl). Progress bar at the top.

grids_and_layouts.dashboard_grid: grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-3 lg:grid-cols-4 gap-6. Summary widgets span 1 col, main chart/table spans 2-3 cols.
grids_and_layouts.spacing: Generous internal padding for containers (p-6 or p-8). Maintain strict optical alignment for numerical columns (right-aligned).
grids_and_layouts.page_structure: Left sidebar (fixed), main content area (scrollable) with a sticky top header for breadcrumbs and page title.

motion.transitions: Fast and purposeful. 150ms ease-in-out for hover states. No dramatic entry animations that slow down the user.
motion.loaders: Minimalist CSS spinners or skeleton loaders (bg-slate-200 animate-pulse) for data tables.

accessibility.contrast: Strict WCAG AA adherence. Grey text must be at least text-slate-500. Buttons must have explicit hover focus states.
accessibility.testing: All interactive elements must have data-testid attributes (e.g., data-testid='quiz-start-button', data-testid='calc-submit').
accessibility.screen_readers: Aria-labels on icon-only buttons (like the sidebar toggle).

landing_hero.description: Office desk with smartphone and financial charts. Use with a subtle gradient overlay to ensure text contrast.

world_explorer_bg.description: Gray minimalist world map. Use as a low-opacity background for the World Tax Explorer section.

calculator_section.description: Calculator and notepad placed over dollar bills. Use as a header image or side-column image for the Save Smart calculators.

leaderboard_iconography.description: Minimalist medal/achievement photo for the leaderboard header or empty state.

libraries.charts: recharts or Shadcn charts for dashboard analytics. Use corporate blue colors for bars/lines.
libraries.3d_animations: NONE. The user specifically requested 'normal and not like something very bulky or flashy'. Stick to clean 2D components.

instructions_to_main_agent: Prioritize a clean, corporate dashboard structure over creative landing pages.
Do NOT use extreme gradients or 3D effects. Rely entirely on precise typography, grid alignments, and high-quality whitespace.
Implement the 'Chivo' font for headers to create an 'Old Money Tech' authoritative feel, while keeping 'Inter' for highly readable data and body text.
Use 'IBM Plex Mono' for all numerical data points inside tables and summary cards.
For the World Tax Explorer, render a clean card-based grid (flags, country names, basic stats) rather than an interactive 3D globe to adhere to the 'not bulky/flashy' constraint.
Build a robust sidebar navigation (dashboard, world explorer, save smart, leaderboard, admin panel).
Ensure all Shadcn components (buttons, inputs) override standard styles to match the #2563eb / #1e3a8a palette.
UNIVERSAL_GUIDELINES_FOR_MAIN_AGENT: Do not center align the app container. Maintain a left-to-right reading flow.
Always use modern button styles (sharp or slightly rounded max 6px) with clear hover state contrast.
Never use AI assistant Emoji characters (🤖🧠💭💡🔮) for icons.
Use 2-3x more spacing (p-6, p-8) to make the data feel auditable rather than cramped.
Ensure no purely transparent backgrounds behind text. Use pure white (#ffffff) cards over the light slate background (#f8fafc).
Add 'data-testid' to all buttons, inputs, and interactive components.
